assumptions_and_limits: All computed results are conditional diagnostics, never corrected yields.
Literal Table3 headers are g/L. Hypothetical grams per 600mL is an alternative unit scenario, not an accepted correction.

Treating nominal grades as active mass fractions and acid85% as mass fraction is explicit; measured batch inventory, moisture, dissolution and NH4 design accounting remain unavailable. Feed Mg/P and reagent impurities are not included in these simple reagent-only molar ratios.

For volume sensitivity only, assume additive stated pH-adjustment volume, no other reagent-volume effects, no evaporation, withdrawals, losses or K-containing additions; actual final volume is unknown.
Model3 two same-key S1 rows have no MgO-source label; their row-order correspondence is only an inference.
